mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5%), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) over two months signal broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth exceeding 1.0% year-over-year during manufacturing expansion cycles supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO growth > 1.0% YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) over six months indicates robust consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS increases for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) over two months signal labor market collapse that reduces household income and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) during manufacturing slowdowns signals economic contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
